sample_unit: states/rows across five retrospective datasets (JIGSAWS, Cholec80, MIMIC-IV, LUMIERE, PhysioNet Sepsis)

links.outcome: Clinician vs standard model vs augmented model accuracy in ICU pressure control, by departure regime
links.effect: In high-departure states augmented model 46.9% vs clinician 20.5% and standard model 19.6%; augmented minus clinician +26.3 points (95% CI 9.3-40.2). Weaker in stable states (25.6%).
links.quote: In ICU pressure control, the augmented model was weaker in stable states (25.6%) but strongest in departure states (46.9%), compared with the clinician (20.5%) and standard model (19.6%) in that regime; the high-departure advantage survived stay-level clustering (augmented minus clinician +26.3 points, 95% CI 9.3-40.2; augmented minus standard +27.2 points, 95% CI 12.4-41.1).

unlisted_practices: Augmenting predictive models with an intervention-aware representation that localizes departure from expected pre-intervention trajectory

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark study evaluating a hybrid human-AI intervention-aware modeling framework across multiple clinical datasets (ICU, surgery, oncology).
